name: @promptdriven/pdd
description: PDD: local Prompting guide, skills and recipes for your coding agent

scripts.test: unit=$(node scripts/list-tests.mjs --unit) && serial=$(node scripts/list-tests.mjs --serial) && [ -n "$unit$serial" ] && { [ -z "$unit" ] || node --import ./test/helpers/test-home.mjs --import ./test/helpers/test-net-guard.mjs --test $unit; } && for f in $serial; do node --import ./test/helpers/test-home.mjs --import ./test/helpers/test-net-guard.mjs --test "$f" || exit $?; done
scripts.check:arch: oxlint -c .oxlintrc.json src bin && depcruise src bin --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --ignore-known .dependency-cruiser-known-violations.json --output-type err-long
scripts.version: node scripts/sync-pypi-version.mjs && git add python/pyproject.toml python/pdd_cli/__init__.py
